model.name: One canonical Class unit per code class (no per-req Class duplication)
model.description: The scenario graph holds AT MOST ONE canonical Class unit per code class - no per-requirement Class duplication. When a chain wires a UseCase to a Class, it REUSES the existing Class node for that code class (adding the method to it), never mints a new Class unit. The existing 55 duplicate Class units (23 code classes, per the audit) are collapsed to one canonical each - methods repointed, every UC.class ref rewritten to the canonical, emptied duplicates removed - so the chain can NEVER again fan out through duplicate Class nodes (by-construction, cannot-happen-again).
model.tronQuote: > TRON (via PO): ONE canonical Class unit per code class — no per-req Class duplication; the chain reuses the existing Class node. By-construction fix (cannot-happen-again).

discoverySource.measured: 163 Class units / 108 distinct code classes / 23 dup names / 55 collapsible duplicate units. Class-per-req sprawl: chains minted a new Class per req instead of reusing the node.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The scenario graph holds AT MOST ONE Class unit per code class (by class name/identity); no per-req duplication.
Wiring a UC to a Class REUSES the existing Class node for that code class (adds the method to it), NEVER mints a new Class unit (the R27.1 pattern).
The 55 existing duplicate Class units (23 code classes, per audit) are collapsed to one canonical each: methods repointed + every UC.class ref rewritten to the canonical + emptied duplicates removed.

The canonical is the unit ON AN ACTIVE CHAIN if one exists (keep its uuid + UC.class refs UNCHANGED, merge the others INTO it) - protecting R26.1 IORResolver b4eaa489 / R25.7+R26.4-5 Room 2172dc56 / R25.4 RbDetailDrawer d86af73d; ELSE the most-methods unit (tiebreak: lowest uuid). The collapse is dry-run + count FIRST, never silently drop a method or break a UC.class ref.
After the fix, minting a chain for a NEW req on an EXISTING code class cannot create a duplicate Class unit (wiring reuses).
A trace audit shows exactly ONE Class unit per code class; no chain fans out through duplicate Class nodes.

gateVerifyCriteria.target: Class units 163 -> 108 (-55 collapsible across 23 code classes)
